note: Advisor defaults, not authoritative. The dataset records which stats an item has, not their sizes, so a weight says how much a stat type matters to the spec (0 to 1); a stat not listed counts 0.

PRIEST/Discipline.rationale: Healer that shields and heals: intellect and spell power drive output, spirit and haste help sustain and cast speed.

PRIEST/Holy.rationale: Pure healer: intellect and spell power first, then spirit for mana and haste or crit for throughput.

PRIEST/Shadow.rationale: Damage-over-time caster: intellect and spell power, with haste and crit speeding up damage; spirit matters little.

ROGUE/Assassination.rationale: Melee poison and bleed damage: agility and attack power lead, with crit and mastery next.

ROGUE/Combat.rationale: Sustained melee damage: agility and attack power, then haste and hit so the swing rate and landing rate stay high.

ROGUE/Outlaw.rationale: Same role as Combat under its newer name: agility first, haste and versatility next.

ROGUE/Subtlety.rationale: Burst melee damage from stealth: agility and attack power, with crit and mastery boosting the burst.
